method: Each comparison changes one declared cue: seedling visibility over an unchanged book; one explanatory text node beside an unchanged cord photo; or the selected ladder/bridge source object within the same frame. Surrounding typography, layout, copy except the declared anchor line, paper and presentation remain fixed. The third case intentionally changes source-object geometry/material appearance; other cases reuse identical photographic bytes/crops.

examples.name: metaphor-book-growth
examples.description: Only seedling-cue opacity changes0→1. The identical book photograph and fixed source window stay untouched; a separately generated transparent seedling appears at fixed x217/y221/166.667×200, with its stem ending at the book gutter. Copy, typography, all other geometry, palette, paper and presentation remain fixed. This is an explicitly fictional photographic composite, not a documented plant growing in a real book.
